# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting Weavewing through GitHub's private vulnerability
reporting: open the **Security** tab of this repository on GitHub and select **Report a vulnerability**. Please do not disclose a vulnerability publicly until the
maintainers have had a reasonable opportunity to investigate and fix it.

Vulnerabilities in upstream T3 Code or in services that T3 Tools operates, such as app.t3.codes and
T3 Connect, belong to upstream: follow
[T3 Code's security policy](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/security/policy).
